stem.text: In this question, X represents an atom of chlorine, bromine or iodine.
Which explanation for the variation in volatility down Group 17 is correct?

A.text: Instantaneous dipole-induced dipole forces between molecules become stronger.

B.text: Permanent dipole-permanent dipole forces between molecules become stronger.

C.text: The bond energy of the $\text{X}_2$ molecules decreases.
